snippet.title: Space Warpster Demo
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426550/Space_Warpster/

This video shows gameplay from a demo of a fast-paced single-player retro arcade shooter inspired by the classic ZX Spectrum games.

The demo features two playable levels, designed to showcase the core gameplay. During combat the player can collect upgrades that enhance weapons, allowing different play styles and increasing replayability.

Both keyboard and gamepad controls are supported.

Available languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian.

Created using Godot Engine, this demo is currently available as an HTML5 build that can be played directly from your browser. Downloadable Windows and Linux builds are also available.

This demo represents an early version of the game and focuses on delivering a pure, high-energy arcade experience. Feedback is welcome and appreciated.

#indiegame #arcadegames #retrogaming
